text:
Carbon dioxide and methane are ‘greenhouse gases’ which contribute to global warming.
Which process does not increase global warming?
A
burning fossil fuels
B
decay of organic waste
C
farming cattle for beef
D
growing crops such as sugar cane

options.label: D
options.text: growing crops such as sugar cane
